title: Brian Stelfreeze
description: "Princess Leia was a great character," observes Brian Stelfreeze, "because she got away from the 'helpless heroine' cliche found in most fantasy literature of this kind." After years of commercial art and product illustration, Stelfreeze took a crack at the comics field in 1988 with a three-issue mini-series entitled CYCOPS, published by Comics Interview. Since then he's done extraordinary work for both Marvel and DC.
